name: cloakbrowser
description: CloakBrowser stealth Chromium through the Playwright MCP tool contract, via cloakbrowser-mcp.

headless.title: Headless
headless.description: Run the browser without a window. Headed mode is measurably less detectable, so leave this off unless you need a server with no display.

browser_engine.title: Browser engine
browser_engine.description: cloak uses the patched CloakBrowser Chromium. playwright uses the stock Playwright Chromium and gives up the stealth patches.

tools_vision.title: Mouse primitives (vision)
tools_vision.description: Six coordinate mouse tools: click, move, drag, down, up and wheel. Off removes them.

tools_devtools.title: Tracing, video and highlights
tools_devtools.description: Thirteen devtools tools: tracing, video, recording, annotations and element highlights. Off removes them.

tools_storage.title: Cookies and web storage
tools_storage.description: Seventeen storage tools: cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage and storage state. Off removes them.

tools_network.title: Network routing
tools_network.description: Four network tools: route, unroute, route list and network state. Off removes request interception.

tools_testing.title: Assertions and locator generation
tools_testing.description: Five testing tools: generate_locator and the four verify_* assertions. Off removes them.

tools_config.title: Configuration read
tools_config.description: browser_get_config. Off removes the configuration introspection tool.

disabled_tools.title: Disabled tools
disabled_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names to hide from the agent and reject when called, for example browser_pdf_save,browser_start_video. Leave empty to expose the selected profile unchanged.

humanize.title: Humanised input
humanize.description: Human-like mouse paths, keystroke timing and scrolling instead of instant synthetic events.

human_preset.title: Humanised input preset
human_preset.description: default is the normal humanised behaviour. careful is slower and more deliberate.

release_channel.title: Engine release channel
release_channel.description: stable is the free channel. preview requires a CloakBrowser Pro licence.

geoip_proxy_match.title: Match timezone and locale to the proxy
geoip_proxy_match.description: Resolve the proxy exit location and align the browser timezone and locale to it. Enable this together with a proxy server.

profile_dir.title: Persistent profile directory
profile_dir.description: Directory that keeps cookies, logins and the fingerprint seed. It is created if it does not exist. Leave empty to use the plugin's own persistent profile in Claude Code's plugin data directory (profiles/default). Use one directory per account.

proxy_server.title: Proxy server
proxy_server.description: Sticky proxy URL, for example http://user:pass@host:port. Leave empty for a direct connection.

proxy_bypass.title: Proxy bypass list
proxy_bypass.description: Comma-separated hosts that should not use the proxy. Leave empty to proxy everything.

licence_key.title: CloakBrowser licence key
licence_key.description: CloakBrowser Pro key. The free tier works without it and allows one concurrent session. Stored in the operating system credential store.

engine_version.title: Engine version pin
engine_version.description: Pin a specific CloakBrowser Chromium build. Leave empty to use the stable channel and let the binary update itself.

output_dir.title: Artifacts directory
output_dir.description: Where Playwright MCP writes screenshots, traces and session files. It is created if it does not exist. Leave empty for the default.
